prompt: This watercolor illustration depicts a bustling school science fair. On the left, a boy in a blue cap stands next to a girl with pigtails who is pointing at a bubbling green potion inside a glass beaker. The beaker sits on a wooden table covered by a white cloth. In the center, a teacher in a gray cardigan looks at a poster board displaying colorful charts. Next to the teacher, a robot with silver arms waves its metallic hand toward a small brown mouse sitting calmly on a red cushion. The mouse is positioned near a cage made of wire mesh. To the right, a man in a red scarf hands a ribbon to a smiling woman in a yellow dress. Behind them, a large potted fern leans slightly against the wall. A black cat sleeps on top of a stack of textbooks nearby. A girl in a pink shirt holds a magnifying glass over a rock sample. A boy in striped socks crouches down to examine the rock closely. There is no digital screen visible in the scene. There is no chalkboard present in the background. The soft washes of color blend gently to define the shapes without harsh outlines, capturing the lively yet gentle atmosphere of the event.
